clue.text: Vehicle reverses into printer's sign, making it collapse

indicators.note: the turned vehicle goes into the printer's mark, so this word signals putting one piece inside another

parts.note: dele is the proofreader's mark meaning delete

indicators.note: the vehicle reverses, so its word is read backwards

parts.note: a cab is a vehicle for hire

explanation.surface: A cab backs into a printer's sign and brings it crashing down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reverses' turns CAB into BAC, which goes 'into' DELE, the proof-correction mark for deletion.
explanation.definitionFit: A debacle is a sudden, disastrous failure, so it is a synonym for a collapse.

clue.text: Manageable clubs in the same French island

indicators.note: the clubs letter goes in between the other two pieces

parts.note: do, short for ditto, means the same
ile is French for island
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: Clubs on a French island are kept easy to handle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the same' is the ditto convention, written do. 'in' is the container signal: the clubs letter goes between the two other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Docile describes something easily managed or controlled, so it is a synonym of manageable.

clue.text: Favourable comment identifying aroma coming from tent?

definitions.meaning: tent is a deep-red Spanish wine, and a wine's scent has a particular name

explanation.surface: A nice word about the smell drifting out of a campsite tent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tent' looks like canvas but is an old name for a red Spanish wine, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a compliment and the scent of a wine.

clue.text: Provide suitable support, say, for queen's complaint

parts.note: to cater is to provide what is suitable

indicators.note: say indicates a word spoken, giving a spelling that sounds like it

parts.note: a wall is a supporting structure

explanation.surface: Laying on proper support, perhaps, in reply to a royal grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'queen' is not royalty but a female cat, whose complaint is a yowl.
explanation.definitionFit: A queen is a female cat, and to caterwaul is to make a cat's howling cry.

clue.text: One who's been elevated is mostly ahead of time

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter is kept

parts.note: early means ahead of time

explanation.surface: A promoted person usually turns up before time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the last letter Y from EARLY.
explanation.definitionFit: An earl is a nobleman, someone elevated to the peerage.

clue.text: Paper's award for identifying cause of magnetic storm

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper; the possessive gives its name plus S
a pot is slang for a trophy cup won as a prize

explanation.surface: A newspaper's prize goes to whoever explains what sets off a magnetic storm.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British daily tabloid; POT is a cup won as a prize.
explanation.definitionFit: Dark patches on the solar surface are linked with bursts of activity that disturb Earth's magnetic field, so they cause geomagnetic storms.

clue.text: Sort of plate' turned out extremely expensive and so pretty!

indicators.note: the letters are turned out into a new order
only the first and last letters of the word are taken

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dish that proved very costly and very attractive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' gives EE, the first and last letters of 'expensive'; with SO and PRETTY they are rearranged ('turned out').
explanation.definitionFit: A stereotype is a printing plate cast from a mould of set type.

clue.text: In autumn it requires a preservative

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of letters that follows

explanation.surface: Autumn produce needs something to keep it fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitre, potassium nitrate or saltpetre, is used to cure and preserve meat.

clue.text: Left in charge of old colonnade

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: An old colonnade abandoned to the care of an official.
explanation.definitionFit: A portico is a porch of columns, a kind of colonnade.

clue.text: Machinist's note about royal psychiatrist

indicators.note: the note goes round the royal letter

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
R is short for royal, as in regina or rex
Alfred Adler was an Austrian psychiatrist

explanation.surface: A factory worker writes a note concerning the royal psychiatrist.
explanation.walkthrough: The note is from the sol-fa scale (doh, ray, me...); Alfred Adler founded individual psychology. 'about' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A treadler works a treadle-driven machine, such as a sewing machine, so is a machinist.

clue.text: Phoney putting plates of meat, say, on bar

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece put on another comes after it

parts.note: a counter is the bar in a pub or shop

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken, giving a spelling that sounds like it

parts.note: rhyming slang: plates of meat means feet

explanation.surface: Someone fraudulently plonking their feet up on the bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plates of meat' is Cockney rhyming slang for feet; 'say' signals a soundalike spelling, and 'on' places it after the bar in an across clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Counterfeit means forged or fake, the same as phoney.

clue.text: At one time, pity odd characters dismissed from troupes

indicators.note: removing the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of the word leaves only the even ones

explanation.surface: Long ago, sympathy was shown when odd performers were sacked from theatre companies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At one time' marks the old sense: rue once meant pity or compassion, not just regret.
explanation.definitionFit: In archaic usage rue meant compassion or pity, as well as sorrow and regret.

clue.text: European museum beginning to locate works out East

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the following word is taken
the east letter is put out of the word for works, so it is removed

parts.note: oeuvre is an artist's body of work

explanation.surface: A guide on how to find the artworks in a museum in eastern Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'works' is a French loan word for an artist's output; 'out' removes the East letter from it.
explanation.definitionFit: The Louvre in Paris is a famous art gallery, an example of a museum in Europe.

clue.text: Lamentation judge associated with English girl in debt

indicators.note: the girl is in debt, so her name goes inside the word for debt

parts.note: being in the red means being in debt
Mia is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A judge laments over an English girl who has fallen into debt.
explanation.walkthrough: Being 'in the red' is the idiom for owing money; 'in' puts the girl inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A jeremiad is a long mournful complaint, named after the prophet Jeremiah's lamentations.

clue.text: Amateur Italian poet accepting unusual title

indicators.note: the poet takes in the rearranged word

parts.note: Dante Alighieri wrote the Divine Comedy

indicators.note: unusual signals the word title in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: An amateur Italian poet takes on an odd title.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' turns TITLE into ILETT, which DANTE is 'accepting'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dilettante dabbles in an art without professional skill, an amateur.

clue.text: Demon driver in mess, consuming the main course

parts.note: Mr Toad in The Wind in the Willows is a reckless motorist

indicators.note: the phrase for being in a mess eats the word the, which goes inside it

parts.note: to be in a hole is to be in a mess or trouble

explanation.surface: A reckless driver in trouble eats up the main meal.
explanation.walkthrough: Toad is the speed-mad motorist of The Wind in the Willows; IN HOLE (in trouble) 'consuming' THE. Toad-in-the-hole is a British dish of sausages baked in batter.
explanation.definitionFit: Toad-in-the-hole, sausages baked in Yorkshire pudding batter, is served as a main dish.

clue.text: Listeners digest actor's words, being in good time

indicators.note: the listeners take in or digest the words, which go inside

parts.note: ears are what we listen with
an actor's lines are the words learned

explanation.surface: Listeners take in a performer's script and arrive on time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'digest' is the container signal here: the listeners take in the performer's words.
explanation.definitionFit: Earliness is the state of being early or punctual, a noun matching being in good time.

clue.text: Second person making impression, one in the 100 metres

parts.note: a printer makes impressions on paper

explanation.surface: A runner-up in a sprint final who made a strong impression.
explanation.definitionFit: The 100 metres is a short dash, run by athletes who specialise in short races.

clue.text: Flyer composing concerto with ornate opening

indicators.note: the ornate piece forms the opening of the answer, standing before the concerto

parts.note: purple prose is ornate, elaborate writing
Beethoven's fifth piano concerto is known as the Emperor

explanation.surface: A pilot passes the time writing a flowery concerto.
explanation.walkthrough: Beethoven's Piano Concerto No 5 is called the Emperor; purple, as in purple prose, means ornate. The purple emperor is a British butterfly.
explanation.definitionFit: The purple emperor is a large woodland butterfly, so it is a flying insect.

clue.text: Soldiers given mining land to bring under cultivation

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
a claim is a plot staked out for mining

explanation.surface: Troops are handed a mining plot to farm.
explanation.walkthrough: RE, the Royal Engineers, are British Army soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: To reclaim land is to make waste or flooded ground fit for farming.

clue.text: Well-fed agent has energy to collect rent

indicators.note: the agent and energy gather up the rent, holding it inside

parts.note: rep is a sales representative or agent
E is the physics symbol for energy
to let is to rent out

explanation.surface: A well-fed agent has the energy to go round collecting rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to collect' is the container signal: agent plus energy gather the rent inside them.
explanation.definitionFit: Replete means full, especially after eating, so well-fed.

clue.text: Son, given scope, rejects new composition

indicators.note: the scope word throws out the new letter

parts.note: extent means range or scope

explanation.surface: A son with room to work turns down a new piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejects' is the deletion signal: the new letter is thrown out of the scope word.
explanation.definitionFit: A sextet is a musical piece written for six performers, a kind of composition.

clue.text: Just beginning popular talk about Old English

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: the chat goes around the letter for old

parts.note: chat means talk

explanation.surface: A trendy chat about Old English for beginners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal: the talk word goes round the old letter, with popular in front and English at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Inchoate means just begun and not yet fully formed, an adjective matching just beginning.

clue.text: Greek character woman's seen in middle of road

indicators.note: the woman is seen inside the two central letters
only the central letters of the word are taken

parts.note: Meg is a woman's name; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: A Greek woman stands in the middle of the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of' road is OA; MEG is 'seen in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet, so a Greek character.

clue.text: Herb may be in front of Simon and behind Peter

definitions.meaning: a medicinal plant was once called a ...

definitions.text: may be in front of Simon and behind Peter
definitions.meaning: ... Simon is the nursery-rhyme figure, and Peter ... is Captain Marryat's naval novel

explanation.surface: A man called Herb is placed between two apostles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Herb' looks like a name in a line-up with Simon and Peter but is the plant. Simple Simon is the nursery-rhyme character; Peter Simple is the 1834 novel by Frederick Marryat.
explanation.definitionFit: Simples were herbs used on their own as medicines, and the word attaches to both names.

clue.text: Wader twice submerged under current

indicators.note: in a down clue, the twice word sits beneath the current letter

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current
bis is Latin for twice, used in music for a repeat

explanation.surface: A wading bird dunked twice beneath the current.
explanation.walkthrough: BIS, Latin for twice, goes 'submerged under' I in the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: The ibis is a long-legged bird that wades in shallow water.

clue.text: Drink a visitor from outer space rejected

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the two pieces are read backwards together

parts.note: ET is the extraterrestrial of the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: An alien turns down the drink it was offered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns A + ET into TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is a common hot beverage, an example of a drink.

clue.text: After which one is entitled to sit with one's peers

definitions.text: After which one is entitled to sit with one's peers

parts.words: After which one is entitled to sit with one's peers
parts.note: read as being given a title of nobility, after which one may sit in the House of Lords among fellow nobles

explanation.definitionFit: Being raised to the peerage gives a title and a seat among fellow lords.

clue.text: Go berserk and violently strike attendant

parts.note: to ram is to strike violently
a page is a boy attendant

explanation.surface: Someone loses control and lashes out at a servant.
explanation.definitionFit: To rampage is to rush about wildly and violently, as going berserk does.

clue.text: Questionable exercise in South American court

indicators.note: the exercise is placed in the run of other pieces

parts.note: PE is physical education

explanation.surface: Doubts arise about a workout held in a South American law court.
explanation.definitionFit: A suspect claim is doubtful or open to question.
